description.zh-CN: 共享运行身份、模型、耗时与原始状态。
description.en: Shared run identity, model, duration and source runtime status.

description.zh-CN: 紧凑运行行；查看与尾部操作使用兄弟目标。
description.en: Compact run row with sibling activation and trailing targets.

description.zh-CN: 独立运行卡片；缺失计数保留为未知。
description.en: Independent run card retaining unknown counts.

description.zh-CN: 同一运行集合的只读分组列表。
description.en: Read-only grouped list over shared run snapshots.

description.zh-CN: 按来源状态派生分列的只读运行看板。
description.en: Read-only run board grouped by source status.

description.zh-CN: 完整受控运行详情，组合请求、执行、产物与关联。
description.en: Complete controlled run detail composing requests, traces, artifacts and relationships.

description.zh-CN: 仅展示来源明确的运行关联与交接。
description.en: Only explicit source relationships and handoffs.

description.zh-CN: 来源用量去重、覆盖说明与分币种合计。
description.en: Deduplicated source usage, coverage and per-currency totals.

description.zh-CN: 共享运行筛选与可选依赖视图受控切换。
description.en: Shared run filters and an optional controlled dependency view.

description.zh-CN: 受控 Agent 工作台；路由、服务与持久化归调用方。
description.en: Controlled Agent workspace; routing, services and persistence belong to callers.

description.zh-CN: 仅展示来源明确的运行依赖；只读画布与可访问列表同步。
description.en: Source-reported run dependencies in a read-only canvas and accessible list.

description.zh-CN: 来源区间历史；运行与币种独立，缺失观测保留断点。
description.en: Source interval history; separate runs and currencies with gaps for missing observations.

description.zh-CN: 可变行高的受控运行列表，保留离屏焦点和完整加载口径。
description.en: Controlled variable-height run list with off-screen focus and explicit loaded scope.

description.zh-CN: 受控流程图基础：统一节点、具名端口、连线、选择和深浅主题。
description.en: Controlled workflow foundations: consistent nodes, named ports, edges, selection and light/dark themes.

description.zh-CN: 可编辑流程工作台：构图、配置、变量、校验、撤销和导入导出。
description.en: An editable workflow workspace for graph editing, configuration, variables, validation, undo and import/export.

description.zh-CN: 按分类和名称查找节点，支持点击新增与拖放目录。
description.en: Find nodes by category and name; add by clicking or dragging from the palette.

description.zh-CN: 复用 Inspector 的受控节点配置，保留无效草稿并校验后应用。
description.en: Controlled node configuration reuses Inspector, preserves invalid drafts and validates before applying.

description.zh-CN: 复用单选 Tree，选择可达上游的兼容输出并生成结构化引用。
description.en: Reuses single-selection Tree to choose compatible, reachable upstream outputs and create structured references.

description.zh-CN: 受控服务面板：版本恢复、讨论、临时 Presence、环境、分享和发布回执。
description.en: Controlled service panel for version restoration, discussions, transient presence, environments, sharing and publication receipts.

description.zh-CN: 显式边界与递归校验的嵌套流程工作台，保留每个子图的选择、视口和本地历史。
description.en: A nested workflow workspace with explicit boundaries and recursion validation, preserving each graph's selection, viewport and local history.

description.zh-CN: 条件、对象 Schema、键值表、表达式和代码的受控编辑器。
description.en: Controlled editors for conditions, object schemas, key-value tables, expressions and code.

description.zh-CN: 受控执行调试：运行、停止请求、审批、脱敏输出和未知结果对账。
description.en: Controlled execution debugging: run, stop requests, approval, redacted output and unknown-outcome reconciliation.

description.zh-CN: 流程图的视觉分组；移动由命令整体更新成员位置。
description.en: A visual workflow group; commands move all member positions together.

description.zh-CN: 流程说明便笺，独立于执行与讨论线程。
description.en: Workflow notes, independent of execution and discussion threads.

description.zh-CN: 受控流程图基础：统一节点、具名端口、连线、选择和深浅主题。
description.en: Controlled workflow foundations: consistent nodes, named ports, edges, selection and light/dark themes.

description.zh-CN: 受控流程图基础：统一节点、具名端口、连线、选择和深浅主题。
description.en: Controlled workflow foundations: consistent nodes, named ports, edges, selection and light/dark themes.

description.zh-CN: 受控流程图基础：统一节点、具名端口、连线、选择和深浅主题。
description.en: Controlled workflow foundations: consistent nodes, named ports, edges, selection and light/dark themes.

description.zh-CN: 组合三种工作项布局与详情，路由和服务由调用方持有。
description.en: Three work item layouts and detail composition; caller owns routing and services.

description.zh-CN: 紧凑Agent工作台骨架：Sidebar、Main、可调整的Inspector与可选底部面板。
description.en: A compact Agent workspace shell with Sidebar, Main, resizable Inspector and optional bottom panel.

description.zh-CN: 当前对象的受控详情，统一 Metadata、缺失字段与复制反馈。
description.en: Controlled object details with shared Metadata, missing-field and copy feedback.

description.zh-CN: SVG 节点画布：选择、临时拖动预览、键盘移动与基本形状绘制。
description.en: SVG node canvas with selection, temporary drag previews, keyboard movement and basic shape drawing.

description.zh-CN: 离线精选素材浏览：分页检索、固定来源、许可证和显式插入副本。
description.en: Offline curated assets with paginated search, frozen provenance, licenses and explicit copy insertion.

description.zh-CN: 受控 SVG 属性：尺寸、几何、填充描边、变换与来源说明。
description.en: Controlled SVG properties for dimensions, geometry, paint, transforms and provenance.

description.zh-CN: 受控 SVG 工作台：素材副本、基本绘图、源码校验、优化与独立导出。
description.en: Controlled SVG workbench with library copies, drawing, validated source, optimization and independent exports.

description.zh-CN: 固定响应网格、独立 Widget、口径查看与受控工具栏。
description.en: Fixed responsive grids, independent widgets, metric inspection and controlled toolbars.

description.zh-CN: 组合状态、趋势、年龄、阻塞、指标和风险事实的固定项目模板。
description.en: A fixed project template combining status, trends, aging, blockers, metrics and risk facts.

description.zh-CN: A/B 样式实验：实时修改圆角、间距、阴影、颜色和字体，比较参数并复制 CSS。
description.en: A/B foundation experiments: adjust radius, spacing, shadows, colors and typography; compare parameters and copy CSS.

description.zh-CN: 逐题单选、多选和文本问卷。
description.en: A stepwise single choice, multiple choice and text questionnaire.

description.zh-CN: 带完整文本替代的轻量柱图和折线图。
description.en: Lightweight bar and line charts with text alternatives.

description.zh-CN: 受控折叠的独立侧栏布局。
description.en: A standalone sidebar with controlled collapse.

description.zh-CN: 复用 CommandPalette 的内嵌命令面板。
description.en: An inline command panel sharing CommandPalette.

description.zh-CN: 调用方提供结果的命令搜索，支持键盘选择与IME。
description.en: Command search with caller-owned results, keyboard selection and IME support.

description.zh-CN: 使用fieldset和legend组织表单分组。
description.en: Form sections using fieldset and legend.

description.zh-CN: 本地图片选择、拖放、预览、替换与失败恢复。
description.en: Local image selection, drop, preview, replacement and failure recovery.

description.zh-CN: 把任务的等待、执行、完成和失败，一眼说清。
description.en: Task waiting, execution, completion and failure at a glance.

description.zh-CN: 六种滚动交互，亲手体验：触发、联动、视差、吸顶、吸附与横向展开。
description.en: Try six scroll interactions: triggered, linked, parallax, sticky, snap and horizontal.

description.zh-CN: 来源阶段与有明确分母的步骤计数，不生成假进度。
description.en: Source stages and bounded step counts without synthetic progress.

description.zh-CN: 按关注 ID 去重；请求数与运行数分别表达。
description.en: Attention ID deduplication with separate request and run counts.

description.zh-CN: 工具审批复用 ToolCall；未知结果必须先核对。
description.en: Tool approval composes ToolCall; unknown results require reconciliation.

description.zh-CN: 产物入口、可用状态与独立审阅摘要。
description.en: Artifact links, availability and independent review summaries.

description.zh-CN: 审阅、业务验收与 PR 状态分别呈现。
description.en: Separate review, business acceptance and PR states.

description.zh-CN: 可观测父子执行步骤与脱敏工具详情。
description.en: Observable parent-child steps and redacted tool detail.

description.zh-CN: 通用受控看板，指针、触屏与键盘移动共享命令。
description.en: Business-independent controlled board sharing pointer, touch and keyboard move commands.
